entries.category_description: Supply of goods and services of a kind normally intended for use in agricultural production but excluding capital goods such as machinery or buildings
entries.comment: The reduced rate shall be applied for Services to combat soil erosion such as Other landscape maintenance services (for the case of wind erosion). For details see art. 291 para. (2) letter e) of the Fiscal Code and point 42 of the Annex to the Order no. 4634/2022, respectively in the Order no. 157/2011.
